work.text: In the picture we see how the Teutonic Thor with his wolves has overwhelmed the cortege of Svantovit. His last warrior is dying on the sacred white steed. … Below the artist-engraver seeks to find inspiration in himself and to resurrect the old Slav aspiration and feeling.

moment.text: He began by visiting the places he intended to depict in the cycle: Russia, Poland, and the Balkans, including the Orthodox Christian monasteries of Mount Athos. Additionally, he consulted historians regarding details of historical events to ensure an accurate depiction. In 1910, he rented part of the castle in Zbiroh and began working on the series.
